observation.initial_state: The camera is positioned looking upwards through a dense canopy of green leaves and dark tree branches. The sun is visible as a bright, starburst-like glare near the center-top of the frame, partially obscured by foliage.
visible_changes: Early frames (0.0s - 1.5s): The camera pans slowly to the right. As it moves, the sun's position shifts towards the left edge of the frame. The intensity of the lens flare fluctuates slightly as the angle changes relative to the light source.

Middle frames (1.5s - 3.0s): The panning motion continues or stabilizes slightly. The sun becomes more obscured by the thick diagonal branch in the foreground, causing the direct glare to dim significantly around the 2.5s mark before re-emerging slightly.

Late frames (3.0s - 3.3s): The camera continues its slow drift/pan to the right. The sun remains high in the background, filtering through the leaves, while the foreground branches shift position across the frame due to the camera movement.
observation.final_state: The view has shifted to the right compared to the start. The sun is still present but appears less central, filtered through different sections of the canopy. The composition is dominated by the diagonal lines of the tree trunks against the bright sky.
uncertain_details: Whether the slight jitter in the image is due to handheld camera shake or wind moving the trees is difficult to distinguish definitively, though the primary motion is clearly a camera pan.
The exact speed of the pan is hard to gauge without external reference points, appearing relatively slow and smooth.
